The '''Breshig system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Contained within the [[Star/Legends|star]] system was the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Breshig]],<ref name="TEAOC" /> and both came under the control of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] following their expanding conquest of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] during their [[Time/Legends|time]] as [[Mandalorian Crusaders]].<ref name="TEA" />
